title: Standby generating sets (one hall) — sequence of operations
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P3. Curated. A threshold is never typed here: a condition names a limit of the conv limits registry (limit), an engine parameter (param) or a value the engine derives (derived); tools/build-sequences.mjs resolves it. A delay that no source states is ASSUMED and says why.

basis.ref: NFPA 110-2022 (emergency and standby power systems) and IEEE Std 446-1995 (Orange Book)
basis.use: the structure: utility failure detected, start signal, sets start and synchronise onto the bus, transfer, retransfer on a stable utility, unloaded cool-down; load shedding when the running sets cannot carry the load
basis.limits: the numbers come from this plant's engine (sets per hall, unit rating, maximum loading, hall design load) and its limits registry, not from the standards

plant: per hall: N + 1 diesel generating sets on a common generator bus behind the transfer switchgear; the IT load rides on 2N UPS. Sets per hall = ceil(hall design load / (unit rating × max loading)) + spare (js/conv-engine.js electrical); on a utility loss the duty sets (count − spare) run and share the hall's facility load, the spare stays on standby (fuel-system.html, the same rule)

modes.label: On utility — sets on standby

entry.text: utility healthy and the transfer switchgear on the utility

actions: every set on automatic standby: jacket-water heater and battery charger on, generator breaker open
the UPS rectifiers take the IT load from the utility; the mechanical load runs on the utility

exit.event: utility voltage or frequency out of tolerance on the incomer

modes.label: Utility failure — UPS on battery, start signal

entry.event: utility voltage or frequency out of tolerance on the incomer

actions: the UPS carries the IT load from its batteries; the mechanical load (chillers, pumps, CRAHs) stops with the utility
after the utility-failure confirmation time, the start signal goes to the duty sets (every set but the spare)
modes.notModelled: battery autonomy and the length of the outage are not modelled in this plant

modes.label: Start and synchronise
actions: the duty sets crank and run up to rated voltage and frequency; the spare stays on standby
the first set ready closes its breaker onto the dead generator bus; the others synchronise and close
the transfer switchgear opens the utility incomer and closes the generator incomer

exit.event: the sets carry the generator bus and the transfer is closed

modes.notModelled: the start time (NFPA 110 Type 10 would be 10 s) is not stated for this plant

modes.label: On generators — load sharing

entry.event: the transfer to the generator bus is closed

actions: the running sets share the hall load
the UPS rectifiers take the IT load back from the batteries
the mechanical plant restarts one machine at a time (the chiller plant's power-failure sequence)

modes.label: Set trip — start the spare

entry.event: a running set trips on its own protection

actions: its generator breaker opens and the set is locked out; alarm
the remaining sets share the hall load
the spare set starts, synchronises and closes onto the bus

exit.event: the spare set is on the bus

exit.text: load above the remaining sets' capacity

modes.label: Load shedding

entry.text: load above the running sets' capacity

actions: shed non-critical and mechanical load in its priority order so the running sets stay within their rating
the IT load stays on the UPS; alarm to the operator
modes.notModelled: the shedding priority list and how much load each step sheds are not modelled

modes.label: Retransfer — back to utility, sets cool down
actions: after the retransfer delay, the transfer switchgear returns the load to the utility
the sets run unloaded for their cool-down, then stop and return to automatic standby

exit.event: every set stopped and on automatic standby

assumed.delay_s 1800: 30 min stable utility before retransfer: common practice for a data centre; no source in this repo states it

scenarios.label: On generators, a running set trips
